children: Customers Bancorp’s net interest income and earnings available to common shareholders rose year over year, as higher average loan balances lifted net interest income and increased commercial lease income and other non-interest income helped offset lower loan fees. Lower credit-loss provision and income tax expense also supported earnings.
² Reported as “Net income available to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share”.
: Tax-equivalent NIM was 3.19%, down from 3.46%, as lower asset yields and discount accretion outweighed a favorable deposit mix and lower deposit rates.
: Commercial lease income increased $4.4M, primarily reflecting growth in the equipment finance business.
: Quarterly net charge-offs were $12.7M, down from $15.4M; lower commercial real estate and consumer installment charge-offs were partly offset by higher commercial and industrial charge-offs.
: Total deposits rose $1.8B, or 8.6%, from December 31, 2025, led by growth in non-interest-bearing demand deposits.
